label: D1 after a rare-unrewarded a1 trial (a1 -> S2, no reward), high value
explanation: Fires only at D1 (100% of mass), only with reward input 0, and essentially only when the previous trial was a1 with a rare transition to S2 (81% of mass; most of the remaining 19% is on the window first trial, where the previous trial is not recorded; previous a2 or previous common gives ~0). That is the model-based stay-on-a1 case: the following choice is a1 in nearly every activation (next action/stay a2/switch ~0). Within that condition it fires on only ~17% of steps. Gating by the model value head (>7.54) raises precision to 0.43 (dev F1 0.54, mass recall 0.77). It is also limited to early/mid episode (none after trial ~65; ep_trial<60 alone gives F1 0.42), and a rewarded trial two back lowers the rate. All predicate variables are observed (value is the model own output), no future variables used. Magnitude is about the same across activation quartiles under the base condition; I did not check what modulates magnitude further. Does not fire at GO or D2, after rewarded trials, or after any a2 trial.
